cards.name: Dwebble
cards.description: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.description: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Necrozma
cards.description: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.description: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.description: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.description: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.description: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn't care too much.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Archen
cards.description: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.description: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.description: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.description: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.description: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.description: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Fomantis
cards.description: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

cards.name: Latias
cards.description: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.description: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.description: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

cards.name: Lurantis
cards.description: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.description: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it "the emperor of dark nights."

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.description: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.description: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.description: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.description: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

cards.name: Audino
cards.description: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: While it's an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.description: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.description: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.description: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.description: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.description: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

cards.name: Silvally
cards.description: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

cards.name: Komala
cards.description: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.description: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.description: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.description: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

cards.name: Finneon
cards.description: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.description: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Lumineon
cards.description: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

cards.name: Basculin
cards.description: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

cards.name: Tirtouga
cards.description: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

cards.name: Carracosta
cards.description: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.description: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.description: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.description: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.description: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.description: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.description: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.description: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is "hodad."

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.description: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.description: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.description: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.description: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Xurkitree
cards.description: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.description: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Wynaut
cards.description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: There's a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you'll be carried away to the afterlife.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.description: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Munna
cards.description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.description: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.description: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.description: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.
